Calculate and return coefficients for extended models

Source: R/get_funs.R
get_par_extend_matrix.Rd

Returns a list of (nmask) x (ntrap) matrices, for each extended parameter. values correspond to estimated parameter value for either (a) The covariate values used to fit the model or (b) The covariate values provided in newdata

Usage

get_par_extend_matrix(fit, mask, traps, session = 1, newdata = NULL, warn = T)

Arguments

fit

an object generated from the model fitting function fit.acre or the bootstrap process boot.acre.

mask

a list or a data frame. Generated by create.mask().

traps

data frame with numeric columns x and y, corresponding to trap coordinates.

session

an integer value indicating the session of detector array and individual(s) to be plotted.

newdata

data.frame; contains any covariates that will be used for all extended parameters.

warn

Logical; warn users if they have not passed all covariates in model specification.

Value

a list of (nmask) x (ntrap) columns, for each extended parameter. values correspond to estimated parameter value for the given covariate values.

Details

Each row corresponds to a trap, and each column a mask point. EXAMPLE: let a model have sigma mask-level extended by brand (2 traps, 1 "sony" and 1 "panasonic"), and also be mask level extended, say with covariate "noise". Then element [1, 1] of the returned sigma element, corresponds to the coefficient of sigma with "sony" brand, and noise at mask point 1. [2, 1] to that of "panasonic" brand, and noise at mask point 1.

Note that because the parameter estimates are calculated for the entire mask, over every trap, newdata argument will be recycled (or truncated), to the correct dimensions.
